concerns.location: tasks.md:T002, T003, T004 vs constitution.md Principle III
concerns.text: T002 ('Output the cleaned training set to data/curated/filtered.csv (in place, preserving schema)'), T003 ('Write the enriched dataset ... back to data/curated/filtered.csv'), and T004 ('write the result to data/curated/filtered.csv') all modify the curated file in place. Constitution Principle III: 'No data may be modified in place; every transformation MUST produce a new file with a documented derivation.' Tasks must write new derived files (or the constitution amended), not silently violate it.

T001 permits 'NIST SRD 150 mirror or equivalent verified public diffusion dataset', weakening FR-001/FR-006 which mandate NIST SRD 150 specifically. It also makes T004's mandated halt message ('not found in NIST SRD 150') potentially false about the actual source. Either restrict to NIST SRD 150 (or a documented verbatim mirror) or amend the spec; do not relax via task wording.

T003 computes electronegativity_diff and valence_electron_diff and writes them into filtered.csv 'conforming to specs/.../contracts/dataset.schema.yaml', but that schema has additionalProperties: false and does not list those columns. The task as written cannot both add the columns and conform to the schema; schema or task must be reconciled.

FR-001 mandates filtering to diffusion_mode == 'self'; T001 splits into solute (training) and self (baseline) per the plan's 'Critical Methodological Correction'. The methodological rationale is sound, but the spec was never amended, so T001's deliverable contradicts the FR it tags. Amend FR-001 (and US-1 scenarios) to authorize the self/solute split rather than letting the task silently override the spec.

T012 verifies only ≤6 h / ≤7 GB (SC-004). Principle VI additionally requires model training <2 CPU-hours and dataset size <10 MB; no task measures or enforces either, so constitutional compliance is never evidenced. Extend T012's resource log to include training CPU-time and dataset size.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006, T001 vs plan.md:Project Structure / FR-SC Coverage Map
concerns.text: Plan maps FR-003 to code/models/train_rf.py and train_gb.py and FR-007 to code/ingestion/ingest.py; T006 consolidates into train_models.py and T001 folds provenance into streaming_loader.py. The consolidation is acceptable, but the plan's file layout and coverage map were not updated, leaving orphan artifacts an implementer following the plan would build. Update the plan to match.

US-2 requires RF/GB training to complete within 15 minutes on a 2-core runner; no task records or verifies per-stage training runtime (only the aggregate 6-hour limit in T012). Add training-time measurement to T006 or T012 so this acceptance criterion survives.

T003 pins periodictable==0.20.1 but never states electronegativity uses the Pauling scale as Principle VII mandates ('The Pauling scale for electronegativity MUST be used consistently'). Add the scale requirement to T003's deliverable/verification.
